m: सम्-√ ऋ P. -इयर्ति, -ऋणोति, -ऋण्वति, or -ऋच्छति (in some forms also Ā.; for -ऋच्छति, ते˚ See Pāṇ. i, 3, 29), to join together, bring to pass, bring about, RV. iii, 2, 1; to bring together, drive together (3. sg. aor. -आरत; perf. p. -आराण), ib. i, 54, 1; to be brought about, ib. iii, 11, 2; to run together, hasten together towards (acc. or loc.), meet with (instr.), come into collision or conflict, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; Kauś.; Bhaṭṭ. : Caus. -अर्पयति, ˚ते, to throw at, hurl at (acc.), strike, hit, AV.; MBh.; to cause to come into conflict or collision, ŚBr.; to fix or place or insert in, put in or on or down, ib. &c., &c.; to impose, enjoin, R.; to deliver over, consign, commit, Kāv.; Kathās.; Sāh.; to send off, despatch (a messenger), R.
a: समृ — {c1c} P. 1 To meet, be united. --2 To come into conflict. --3 To bring together, construct. --Caus. (समर्पयति) 1 To hand over, deliver, commit, consign. --2 To give, present. --3 To place in, put in or on, --4 To strike, hit. --5 To restore, return.

m: सम्-ऋछ् See सम्-√ ऋ, p. 1170.

सम्-√ ऋध् P. -ऋध्यति, -ऋध्नोति (Ved. inf. -ऋधे), to succeed well, prosper, flourish, increase or grow greatly, Mn.; MBh. Pass. -ऋध्यते, to be completely successful, be fulfilled or accomplished, succeed, prosper, RV.; AV.; ChUp.; R.; to share in abundantly, be amply furnished with (instr.), ŚBr. : Caus. -अर्धयति, to cause to succeed or prosper, accomplish, fulfil, VS.; ŚBr.; to cause to be abundantly furnished with (instr.), ib.; to bestow liberally on (dat.), BhP.
सम्-ऋध् f. success, welfare, RV. vi, 2, 10.
a: समृध् — {c4c} {c5c} P. To thrive, prosper, flourish. --Pass. 1 To be fulfilled or accomplished, succeed. --2 To share in abundantly, be fully furnished (with instr.).

m: सम्-˚ऋध mfn. full, complete, perfect, ib. viii, 103, 5.
सम्-ऋच् See सम्-√ अर्च्, p. 1156.
सम्-ऋ˚द्धार्थ mfn. having increased substance or wealth, increasing in resources, R.
समृद्धी-√ कृ P. -करोति, to make prosperous or wealthy, Daś.

s: tri, (sam + fDu vfdDO + ktaH .) samfdDiyuktaH । tatparyyAyaH । aDikardDiH 2 । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 11 ॥ aDisampattiSAlI 3 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 2 । 14 । 27 ॥ “saMhfzwamanujopetAM samfdDavipaRApaRAm ॥” nAgaviSeze, puM । iti mahABAratam । 1 । 57 । 17 ॥)
v: tri॰ samyak fdDaH fDa--kta । 1 aDikasampattiyukte amaraH । 2 ativfdDe ca SabdamA॰ ।
m: सम्-ऋद्ध mfn. accomplished, succeeded, fulfilled, perfect, very successful or prosperous or flourishing, fortunate, AV.; Br.; ChUp.; MBh.; R.
full-grown (as trees), MBh.
complete, whole, entire, ib.
fully furnished or abundantly endowed with (instr. abl., or comp.), ŚBr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
rich, wealthy, ib.; Kathās.
plenteous, abundant, much, Ratnāv.
सम्-ऋद्ध m. N. of a serpent-demon, MBh.
a: समृद्ध — p. p. 1 Prosperous, flourishing, thriving. --2 Happy, fortunate. --3 Rich, wealthy. --4 Rich in, richly endowed with, abounding in. --5 Fruitful. --6 Full-grown, increased. --7 Full, complete, entire. --8 Copious, abundant.

k.v: अधिभूर्नायको नेता प्रभुः परिवृढोऽधिपः। अधिकर्द्धिः समृद्धः स्यात्कुटुम्बव्यापृतस्तु यः॥

m: सम्-ऋद्ध—तेजस् mfn. endowed with splendour or strength, R.
सम्-ऋद्ध—वेग mfn. increasing in speed, excessively swift, Bhag.
सम्-ऋद्ध—यशस् mfn. rich in fame, renowned, celebrated, MW.

s: strI, (sam + fD + ktin .) samyagvfdDiH । atiSayasampattiH । tatparyyAyaH । eDA 2 । ityamaraH । 3 । 2 । 10 ॥ viDA 3 । iti jawADaraH ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 9 । 13 । “caraRayornaKarAgasamfdDiBirmukuwaratnamarIciBiraspfSan ॥”)
v: strI samyak fdDiH sam + fDa--ktin vA । 1 atisampattO amaraH 2 samyagvfdDO ca “maDusamfdDisameDita yA meDayA” mAGaH ।
m: सम्-ऋद्धि f. great prosperity or success, growth, increase, thriving, welfare, fortune, perfection, excellence (ifc. = ‘increased by’), AV.; ŚBr.; Up.; MBh. &c.
abundance, plenty of (comp.), Kāv.
wealth, riches (also pl.), Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
N. of a partic. Vedic hymn (causing prosperity), VarBṛS.
a: समृद्धिः — f. 1 Great growth, increase, thriving; मधुसमृद्धिसमेधितमेधवा Śi. 6. 20. --2 Prosperity, opulence, affluence; Pt. 1. 169; Bh. 2. 42. --3 Wealth, riches. --4 Exuberance, profusion, abundance; as in धनधान्यसमृद्धिरस्तु. --5 Power, supremacy.

k.v: विधा समृद्धौ स्फुरणे स्फुरणा प्रमितौ प्रमा। प्रसूतिः प्रसवे श्च्योते प्राधारः क्लमथः क्लमे॥

m: सम्-ऋद्धि—काम (सम्˚), mfn. desirous of pr˚, ŚBr.
सम्-ऋद्धि—करण n. means of procuring prosperity, PārGṛ.
सम्-ऋद्धि—मत् mfn. perfectly succeeding or successful or fortunate, MBh.; Naiṣ.; MārkP.
richly furnished with (comp.), Kāvyād.
सम्-ऋद्धिन् mfn. possessing abundance of (comp.), MBh.; R.
prosperous, happy, blessed (said of Gaṅgā), MBh.
सम्-ऋद्धि—समय m. a season of great prosperity, MW.
सम्-ऋद्धि—वत् mfn. (prob. w.r.) id., Śaṃk.
सम्-ऋद्धि—वृद्धि-लाभ m. acquisition of increase of prosperity, MBh.
सम्-ऋत mfn. come together, met, RV.
come into conflict or collision (see next)
सम्-ऋत—सोम m. pl. concurrent Soma-sacrifices, ib.
सम्-ऋत—यज्ञ m. pl. coincident or concurrent sacrifices, TS.
सम्-˚ऋति (सम्-), f. coming together, meeting, contact, RV.
conflict, war, fight, ib.
सम्-√ 1. ऋष् P. -अर्षति, to come together, meet with (instr.), RV.; to come together to (acc.), AV.
